strategic_assessment.headline: The org is stalled at the manual approval bottleneck: 13 funnel fixes and the entire content engine are waiting on Krish.
strategic_assessment.body:
The automated pipeline remains paralyzed at the human layer. Leo's 13 critical funnel fixes, including the Stripe webhook and CTAs, are still awaiting Krish's approval. Cleo's Content Engine Weekly Sweep has yet to execute because Tier 1 posts require manual pasting. Nova has the podcast pipeline ready, and Nell is prepared for outbound, but initiating outreach without a functioning conversion funnel and active content is a waste of leads.

The market is moving fast—enterprise buyers are demanding measurable ROI over generic AI courses, and publisher pain points regarding agentic web traffic are escalating (AI bots now driving 2% of traffic). We have the solutions to these precise pain points, but we are completely silent.
strategic_assessment.recommended_focus: Approve Leo's top 3 funnel fixes (especially Stripe/CTAs) today to process conversions, and unblock Cleo's content publishing so Nell's outreach has a warm landing pad. All outbound is paused until the funnel works.
